outputs.explanation: Panel A shows only micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, Merge channels); no plot of averaged data is present.
The two bar graphs (JC-1 relative intensity Green/Red and anti-HMGB1 intensity) show group means with error bars (n=20) but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantification plot of averaged values.
The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar graphs display group means with error bars (N=15-26 indicated in bars) but do not show the individual data points underlying the averages.

Panel E consists of FACS histogram plots (cell counts vs. TMRM intensity) rather than bar/summary charts of averaged values; histograms inherently display the distribution of raw data, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
